page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8y.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the custom Alibaba Yitian 710 processor. Built on the arm64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.75 GHz. It is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated resource allocation for demanding workloads.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfer rates for distributed architectures. The custom Yitian 710 Arm-based processor offers a highly resource-dense and cost-efficient hardware profile compared to traditional x86 architectures, making it suitable for organizations looking to optimize their cloud infrastructure spend.

The ecs.r8y.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from the energy efficiency and high core density of Arm architecture. Suitable use cases include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and data processing pipelines that require substantial memory capacity without the need for local physical storage or hardware acceleration.
